ui.chat.response_actions.label.role: accessible name of the hover-revealed toolbar under a settled agent response that does not close its turn (Copy alone)
ui.chat.response_actions.label.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.response_actions.label.note: Screen-reader only. Must differ from the closing answer's "Answer actions" toolbar, so a turn with several responses does not announce several identical toolbars.

ui.chat.response_actions.answer_label.role: group name for the toolbar of actions on an agent's answer
ui.chat.response_actions.answer_label.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.response_actions.answer_label.note: Screen-reader only: it labels the icon row revealed on the answer, and the buttons inside are icons. It names what the actions act on, not who wrote the row.

ui.chat.response_actions.copied.role: accessible name and tooltip of the copy control immediately after it copied the message
ui.chat.response_actions.copied.tone: plain past-tense statement, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.response_actions.copied.note: The confirmed state of the copy control; it returns to the imperative 'Copy' after a short delay.

ui.chat.response_actions.copy.role: accessible name and tooltip of the control that copies the whole message
ui.chat.response_actions.copy.tone: verb, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.response_actions.copy.note: Copies the message's plain text to the clipboard. It sits in the row of icon actions on a message, not in the transcript's text-selection toolbar.

ui.chat.response_actions.yours_label.role: group name for the toolbar of actions on the reader's own message
ui.chat.response_actions.yours_label.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.response_actions.yours_label.note: Screen-reader only: the same icon row as the answer's, on a row the reader wrote. The possessive makes the subject plain without repeating the message text.
